days.title: Orientation
intro: Human Verification Corporation, fourth floor. Identity Services.
The job offer said: "You will read what people write and decide whether a person wrote it." It did not say much else.
Your office is room 0417. Somebody has already adjusted the chair.

days.title: Patterns
intro: Second day. The corridor smells of carpet cleaner and warm dust.
Yesterday you decided whether a woman was a woman. Nobody asked how you felt about that.
There is a new file in your queue. A contractor. Routine, they said.

days.title: Memory
intro: You are almost sure the photograph in your office showed the corridor from the other end.
Today's subject works in Human Resources. She has verified more people than you have met.
Someone has taken a nameplate off a door on this floor. The screw holes are still clean.
boot_lines: NOTICE: DIRECTORY REINDEXED. 1 ENTRY NOT FOUND.

days.title: Contamination
intro: It is very quiet. You cannot hear the other offices today.
You catch yourself rereading your own notes to check that they still sound like you.
The file in your queue belongs to the friendliest man in Customer Support.
boot_lines: WARNING: 14 FILES MODIFIED WHILE TERMINAL WAS OFF

days.title: The Missing Record
intro: Friday. A company-wide verification sweep is scheduled for 17:00. All staff.
The last file in your queue belongs to the woman who keeps the medical records.
You try to remember the Friday before you started here. You try for longer than you would like.
boot_lines: WARNING: PROFILE 0417 HAS NO PARENT RECORD
WARNING: svc-continuity HOLDS A LOCK ON THIS SESSION
